_about: Hand-maintained pin maps shared by merge_pms_performance.js, pin_pms_alias.js, merge_reckoner.js and merge_aif_performance.js (KNOWN_ISSUES A18). Edit pins HERE, never in the tools. A wrong pin puts another manager's numbers on a client's fund: confirm every change with the owner (D61).

Every name is matched byte-for-byte against live data. Never trim, re-space or re-case a name. trailing_space lists, per section, the names (keys or targets) that end in a space ON PURPOSE because the live MASTER record does. Each of the four tools refuses to run if a section's names with an edge space differ from that list: a deliberate space was lost, or a stray one was added (KNOWN_ISSUES A25).

pms_alias: MASTER PMS fund name -> exact scheme key in the PMS_Scheme_Performance file (PMS_PERFORMANCE.pms). repin: merge_pms_performance.js points PMS_PERF_ALIAS at the key on every run and stops if the new file lacks it. pin: pin_pms_alias.js points PMS_PERF_ALIAS at the key and checks it against the PMS block on disk (run it straight after merge_pms_performance.js --apply). why: printed by pin_pms_alias.js. note: documentation only.
reckoner: Reckoner deck name -> MASTER name, used by merge_reckoner.js where normalisation cannot bridge the gap. reckoner_notes: documentation only.
aif_performance: the deck names merge_aif_performance.js pins. Each is looked up in reckoner, so the AIF grid and Centricity Select resolve a deck name the same way.
